intro.text: A pungent antiseptic oil of Roshar, spread over wounds to prevent infection. It drives off rotspren.

description.text: Surgeons prefer it to larmic mucus, knobweed sap or soap and water.

items.text: It was used in the hospitals of Kharbranth, where the surgeon Vathe had studied at the Great Concourse.
Vathe taught his apprentice Lirin to use it, and Lirin used it often, including on Sani's injury.

Lirin passed what he knew to Kaladin, who used it when he could and often wished for more. On the Shattered Plains an apothecary charged two sapphire marks a bottle, about five times the price of larmic mucus.
Shallan Davar was treated with it in Kharbranth after cutting herself on broken glass.
